nieuw.tekst: In Breakthrough, consider five-model units of Ellyrian Reavers in marching column to reach the opponent's board edge and leave the board for bonus points.
nieuw.waarom: He says their movement of nine allows a 27-inch triple march in marching column, covering a large part of the board.
nieuw.voorbeeld: Having to deploy first, he placed two units of five Ellyrian Reavers at opposite extremes of his deployment zone because he did not know where his opponent would deploy.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: His opponent stacked both flanks to block a direct run. He abandoned that approach on the left and reformed the Reavers behind his Sisters of Avelorn.

bronnen.citaat: units of five reavers and deployed them in marching column

extraCitaten.citaat: 27 inches which is crazy it's like a vast majority of the board

nieuw.titel: Widen Reavers to fight through a blocked Breakthrough route
nieuw.tekst: When Scouts blocked his Reavers' Breakthrough route, he redressed the marching column into a five-wide formation to prepare a charge. Consider this approach to clear the blocker and overrun towards the exit, subject to his uncertainty about the precise redressing movement.
nieuw.waarom: He needed to break through the Scouts and reach the board edge before the nearby Knights could intercept him.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He widened the Reavers, destroyed the Scouts with a charge the following turn and overran beyond the Knights' charge arc. He then took the Reavers off the board on the next turn.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He had to endure a turn of Scout shooting after widening. He questions whether all models can redress to one side and says he would have left more space if redressing had to be centred; he and his opponent thought the movement worked, but he asks for clarification.

bronnen.citaat: I redressed them into a unit of five wide

extraCitaten.citaat: overrun and then I was able to break through past these Knights

nieuw.titel: Question bows on Reavers that spend their time marching
nieuw.tekst: Consider leaving bows off Ellyrian Reavers that spend much of their time marching. He is unsure whether bows are worth taking and does not think they add much.
nieuw.waarom: He says the Reavers spend a lot of time marching.

bronnen.citaat: I don't think they really add much
